overview.about: The CPKC Women's Open is Canada's national women's championship on the LPGA, moving between the country's leading courses. Steeped in history and backed by huge home support, it is one of the most prestigious non-major titles a player can win.
overview.nextEvent: The next CPKC Women's Open is played at Earl Grey Golf Club in Calgary. As Canada's national women's open, it draws strong galleries and a world-class field.
